verdicts.reason: A keeps the original's structure: the headline sits on one line in the T's red crossbar, the stem bleeds off the bottom edge, and the text is readable. But it is a centred, shrunken copy that leaves large empty blue areas on the left and right, the text is small for the banner, and the right side of 'AGAINST CRUELTY' runs off the red stem onto blue. B wraps the headline so 'NOW!' sits alone on its own line, which breaks the original's one-line headline. Its T now floats with a gap above the bottom edge instead of bleeding off, the crossbar is cramped around the text, and it has the same dead blue side areas.
